tool_args.rationale: Across eight rows, y/u_now stays close to 2.36 while x_now varies substantially, consistent with horizon-dependent Kelvin–Voigt creep and inconsistent with the x_now dependence of Newton cooling. The available horizon variation and proportional amplitudes suffice for numerical parameter fitting; do not purchase more measurements.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It predicts a response dependent on x_now; observed y/u_now is nearly constant despite large x_now variation.
It predicts nonlinear dependence on u_now, while observed y is approximately proportional to u_now across the range.
The acquired rows already span multiple horizons and strongly show amplitude proportional to u_now; no further paid observation is needed to fit the two-parameter creep law.
It is explicitly irrelevant and prohibited by the measurement guidance.
